verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS security and compliance platform with a public API, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis. The evidence never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The only event-subscription mechanism shown is email notifications on the status page, and the public OpenAPI, MCP server and service keys are adjacent features, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
